exposure: Weight-bearing exercises (wall push-ups, chair squats, shrugs, leg raises, brisk walking)
cohort: Sixty menopausal women from Karumbukuppam village, Gummidipoondi taluk, Thiruvallur district, India, were randomly assigned to an experimental or control group.
finding: Weight-bearing exercises significantly reduced sleep disruption and low back pain among menopausal women in the experimental group compared to their pre-test scores.
